author: Emmylou
body:
Dear Avicus Staff,

I'm writing this appeal in regards to my most current and only infraction that I received on June 26th. I got a warning for void shooting but after asking multiple staff about the policy of void shooting I have not been given a straight answer as to whether or not it is allowed or not allowed. Today I was talking with Junr about it and he referred me to the rules page. On the rules page through this link https://avicus.net/rules/en, I did not see anywhere where it said void shooting was not allowed. In this case I would like to appeal my infraction since Junr informed me that it is not due to be updated to the rules until the next Avicus update. Hopefully you will consider this and look into if there is a discrepancy about void shooting and whether it is allowed or not. I find it frustrating to be punished for something that is not in the rules and that many staff have a varied opinion about. Please take time to consider this and thank you for taking the time to read this appeal. I am not a rule breaking on Avicus and I try my hardest to not break the rules, as you can see by my lack of infractions, so I hope to resolve this if at all possible.


Thanks,

Emmylou

title: Void Shooting Infraction - First Offense

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body: It was fixed so if some people are still able to shoot themselves in the void then it would be classed under Abusing Glitches. This is why Acceqted has put Abusing Glitches in the punishment reason. I'll let Acceqted handle the rest.

Do not intentionally take advantage of server exploits that give you an advantage of other players. Doing so may result in a severe punishment, depending on its severity. In many instances we would highly encourage you to email support@avicus.net with details regarding the potential server exploit.

Mqderator/Josh
